# thoth_data_handling (Resource)

What Thoth keeps of your agents' tool arguments, prompts and tool output. Applied when data reaches Thoth, before it is queued or stored. Destroying this resource returns the workspace to the private defaults: hashed arguments and no prompts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thoth_data_handling" "this" {
  tool_arguments = "hash" # store | hash | redact | drop
  prompts        = "drop" # store | hash | drop
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `prompts` (String) Prompts, model output and tool results: `store`, `hash` the whole text with a workspace-keyed HMAC, or `drop`. Default `drop`.
- `tool_arguments` (String) Tool arguments: `store` as sent, `hash` each value with a workspace-keyed HMAC (argument names kept), `redact` each value to its type, or `drop`. Default `hash`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier (tenant ID).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID resolved from provider configuration.

## Import

Import using the tenant ID:

```shell
terraform import thoth_data_handling.this <tenant_id>
```
